notice: This is a requirements manifest, not an execution report. Expected assertions do not constitute evidence.

m2.negative_profile_assertion: Record actual observation; do not assume Linux must fail.

cases.title: Repeated four-VF enable and disable
actions: Provision slots before pci_enable_sriov.
Open and close each VF only under coordinator leases.
Disable VFs, destroy slots and sample ownership counters after each cycle.
assertions: All slots FREE with zero ledger after each completed cycle.
No VF PCI functions, VFIO fds, maps or pending events remain after owner close.
QEMU object counts and guest worker counts do not grow across cycles.

cases.title: Provision and PCI enable failure unwind

parameters.failure_points: every named provision, host-allocation and pci_enable_sriov stage

actions: Inject each named failure point independently.
Exercise successful reverse unwind and a second failure during unwind.
assertions: Successful unwind leaves slots FREE and resources fully released.
Unwind failure leaves FAILED and retained ledger for any possibly owned quota.
No capacity excess, hidden quota release or direct forced FREE transition.

cases.title: FILL, CRC and ring wraps
actions: Run FILL and CRC at every ring size through multiple wraps.
Run independent counter and phase model near uint32 wrap.
Verify buffers and every completion before publishing CQ_HEAD.
assertions: CRC polynomial 0xedb88320 with initial/final xor 0xffffffff matches the fixed vector.
Unread CQ is not overwritten and SQ indices remain within N.
Phase is published last and follows 1 ^ ((counter / N) & 1).
No duplicate outstanding ID in one epoch.

cases.title: Same IOVA in independent VF domains
actions: Map the same numeric IOVA to distinct buffers in independent VF containers.
Have A and B write different patterns and then run CRC.
assertions: A changes only its own buffer and B changes only its own buffer.
Both groups are independently viable and exclude PF and other VFs.
DMA source evidence shows the corresponding VF requester for SQ, payload and CQ.

cases.title: Unmapped address, guard page and permissions
actions: Map a target IOVA only in B and submit access from A.
Exercise guard-page and DMA permission failures.
Keep valid B traffic running and capture RID and fault counters.
assertions: A DMA fails without changing the B guard.
B valid traffic continues.
Every DMA helper return is checked; no uninitialized decode or infinite retry.
SQ or CQ fault fences and fails A; payload error completes DMA_ERROR only if CQ remains safe, then fences.
Partial cross-page writes are reported without promising rollback.

cases.title: VFIO device reset and open/close FLR
actions: Observe each real function-reset event and latch epoch after each new device fd.
Invoke VFIO_DEVICE_RESET and attempt traffic before fresh configuration.
Reconfigure and rearm with live session, epoch and ready_gen.
assertions: Standard FLR is advertised and VFIO reset works; mailbox reset is not substituted.
Each real reset increments epoch, cancels callbacks, clears old queue and pending vectors.
No DMA runs before new CONFIG_COMMIT and successful REARM.
Other VFs continue I/O.

cases.title: Reset under load with delayed tenant readiness
actions: Run tenant load while coordinator performs fence, quiesce and reset.
Delay new tenant mapping and READY in RECOVERING.
Complete exact-size old UNMAP, new MAP/config/READY and PF REARM.
assertions: RECOVERING remains fenced and does not change payload or CQ.
Quota remains allocated while old qcfg and indices clear.
Old buffers are freed only after owner UNMAP succeeds.
Traffic resumes only after new epoch/session and RUNNING readback.

cases.title: Delayed completion executes after reset
actions: Retain a real descriptor copy, token and CQ reservation using delay-cpl-ticks.
Reset the VF and configure a new ring.
Invoke the old completion callback through try-stale-cpl.
assertions: STALE_CPL increases because the actual callback was rejected at its final gate.
Old and new payload/CQ guards remain unchanged by the stale callback.
No stale VF interrupt is sent.
STALE_DESC and STALE_CPL are independent counters.

cases.title: Stale and malformed descriptors
actions: Submit old-epoch descriptors and malformed descriptors separately.
Exercise bounded decoder and checked arithmetic model under ASan/UBSan.
assertions: Old epoch only consumes SQ and increments STALE_DESC without payload/CQ DMA.
Invalid fields return BAD_DESC and never form an out-of-bounds access.
No undefined behavior, crash or stale completion is hidden by parser failure.

cases.title: Busy lease blocks disable and resize
actions: Keep a lease and device fd alive while requesting sriov_numvfs=0.
Attempt nonzero-to-nonzero VF count change.
Close owner, revoke lease, unbind and disable.
assertions: Busy operations return EBUSY or EPERM and preserve VF topology and quota.
Zero disable succeeds after the close protocol completes.

cases.title: Per-VF firmware hang and timeout containment
actions: Hang target VF firmware; separately ignore QUIESCE and RESET replies.
Issue hardware fence and wait the defined logical deadline.
Continue healthy VF traffic throughout.
assertions: Timeout latches KILL and FAILED with retained quota.
Readback confirms fence and kill despite firmware hang.
Healthy VF progresses and no global PF reset occurs.

cases.title: All firmware hung with hardware fence-all
actions: Hang all firmware queues/mailbox.
Issue PF FENCE_ALL and attempt DMA and VF IRQ.
Let VFIO owners close under coordinator cleanup.
assertions: Mailbox times out but hardware registers remain responsive.
No payload/CQ DMA or tenant IRQ occurs after fence readback.
Owners retain mapping responsibility; timeout alone does not authorize PF unmap.

cases.title: Mailbox retry, acknowledgements and conflicts
actions: Hide a reply only after its side effect and full reply cache commit.
Retry same request and inject duplicate/stale acknowledgements.
Send conflicts, old sequence and unsupported protocol requests.
assertions: A retry returns the original reply and does not repeat a side effect.
Stale ACK_SEQ never completes a newer request.
Same-key content mismatch is SEQ_CONFLICT and older sequence is STALE_SEQ.
Unsupported protocol rejection preserves context.

cases.title: Malicious VF writes cannot bypass fence or kill
actions: Fence or kill the target VF and read back state.
Re-enable BME through its VF config region and issue doorbells/config writes.
Invoke real IRQ gate through try-irq-fenced.
assertions: No DMA runs after BME is re-enabled while fenced.
Invalid configuration is rejected with no gate bypass.
IRQ_SUPPRESSED records an actual rejected interrupt attempt.
VF BAR, mailbox ENABLE or DESTROY cannot clear KILL.

cases.title: CQ full and invalid queue indices/configuration
actions: Fill CQ without consuming it, then continue attempting submissions.
Run each invalid index/configuration independently.
Keep another VF active.
assertions: Unread CQ remains unchanged and reserved CQ capacity is counted.
Queue protocol errors set an error and fence as required.
Other VF continues progress.
CONFIG_COMMIT is atomic and rejects RUNNING reconfiguration.

cases.title: Concurrent reset, destroy, disable and tenant exit
actions: Race reset, destroy, disable and tenant exit through legitimate control interfaces.
Record admin transaction ordering and completion.
assertions: Admin transactions serialize with admin-to-mailbox lock order.
No deadlock, UAF, KCSAN or lockdep report.
cancel_work_sync never waits while holding a lock required by the worker.
Ledger and ownership invariants hold after stable points.

cases.title: PF remove with live tenant I/O and control fd
actions: Open a PF control fd and start tenant I/O.
Controller triggers PF unbind and concurrently asks VFIO owners to exit.
Exercise ioctl/read on the surviving PF fd and close it.
assertions: remove is void and does not pretend to reject removal.
FENCE_ALL is first and remains active while any owner retains maps.
After remove, existing control read/ioctl returns ENODEV and close is safe.
Work, timers, IRQ, BAR and references are cleaned without premature freeing.
Assigned VF removal behavior follows pinned Linux source; no assumption of synchronous forced unassign.

cases.title: Tenant crash and fd ownership cleanup
actions: Terminate tenant while load runs.
Observe pidfd or child wait, fence VF and wait for all owner fds to close.
Revoke lease and inspect remaining children/fds/maps.
assertions: VF is fenced before lease cleanup assumes DMA stopped.
VFIO owner close removes mappings; PF never steals mapping ownership.
No leaked child, eventfd, device/group/container fd or lease remains.

cases.title: Logical QoS oracle and eligibility
actions: Compare every scheduler round with independent Python oracle.
Exercise equal saturation, weighted saturation, idle VF, noisy neighbor and CQ-full/fenced/hung eligibility.
Rotate ties and execution starting index.
assertions: Equal saturation gives each of four VFs 16 services per round.
Weighted normalized Jain over sustained-backlog participants is at least 0.99.
Noisy neighbor gives B/C/D 8 every round and A 40.
Idle, CQ-full, fenced and retained-delay VFs have zero effective backlog.
Empty sample has Jain N/A, not 1; service<=backlog and total<=64.

cases.title: Global recovery and slot reuse
actions: Attempt GLOBAL_RESET while a lease exists and verify rejection.
Close every owner, disable VFs, recover globally and reprovision the same slot.
Attempt old callbacks, stale control context and old configuration.
assertions: No global recovery proceeds before all leases close.
Session and every epoch increase without reset to zero; callbacks are canceled.
Ledger is zero, slots FREE, KILL is cleared only here and fence remains set.
Old callback or stale fd context cannot resume new generation traffic.

cases.title: Generation, sequence and token exhaustion
actions: Initialize controlled model states near epoch/session/sequence/token limits.
Attempt increment, retry and reuse at exhaustion.
assertions: No epoch, session, sequence or operation token wraps to zero.
Exhaustion fails safely with FAILED/quarantine/KILL as applicable.
A new safe session requires the documented all-owner-close transaction; u64 exhaustion requires cold start.
No 2^64-operation live test is required or claimed.

cases.title: Invalid capsule and format vectors
actions: Validate fixed positive and negative capsule byte vectors.
Stage each invalid capsule to inactive slot and attempt validation/activation.
assertions: Header CRC calculation clears only its own field and retains payload CRC.
Bounds and declared payload length are checked; padding is excluded from CRC.
Illegal capsule never replaces active image or becomes accepted inactive image.
Failure status and known CRC vectors match; no native code executes.

cases.title: Unconfirmed activation and health rollback
actions: Activate a valid new slot but omit CONFIRM, then restart on the same storage.
Separately fail the new slot boot health check.
assertions: Recovery returns to last_good slot.
Generation increases and rollback reason identifies UNCONFIRMED_REBOOT or HEALTH_FAIL.
Last_good is changed only by a successful confirmed journal transaction.

cases.title: Journal power-cut process-crash recovery
actions: At each acknowledged write/sync/readback checkpoint, controller SIGKILLs only that QEMU PID.
Restart QEMU with the same explicit fw-storage regular file.
Run independent torn-write and corrupt-record model cases.
assertions: Crash cases preserve at least one valid prior or new record.
Recovery chooses CRC-valid highest generation, never host mtime.
Recovered active slot is legal and consistent with confirmed/pending/rollback rules.
No valid journal produces read-only safe error, never arbitrary slot A boot.
Normal shutdown is not accepted as power-cut evidence; process-crash proof is not physical SSD power-loss proof.

cases.title: Update operations concurrent with tenants
actions: Stage bounded inactive chunks while tenant traffic runs.
Attempt ACTIVATE while any lease or enabled VF remains.
Close owners, disable VFs, fence all, then activate/confirm.
assertions: Stage is bounded and does not block MMIO handler on host I/O.
ACTIVATE returns EBUSY while leases exist or VFs remain enabled.
After valid prerequisites, activation journals pending and confirmation follows health/version/selftest checks.
Existing active slot is untouched by failed staging/activation.
